Question B-006-008-008.

Why the correct answer is right: End insulators mark the electrical end of the antenna and keep support ropes from becoming part of its length.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "To limit the electrical length of the antenna": Correct. End insulators mark the electrical end of the antenna and keep support ropes from becoming part of its length.
- sourceIndex 1: "To decrease the effective antenna length": Front-to-back ratio is a pattern-power comparison, not a dimension ratio.
- sourceIndex 2: "To increase the antenna bandwidth": Those are different performance topics; feed-point matching reduces high-SWR feedline loss.
- sourceIndex 3: "To reduce capacitive coupling with the ground": This does not match the principle tested here: Wavelength, resonance, loading, and traps all connect physical antenna length with operating frequency.
